task: Add explicit decision answer-and-resume for linked active CLI sessions.

resource_risks.description: Answer-and-resume writes user-provided text to a live CLI session stdin.
resource_risks.mitigation: The command only writes after saving the decision answer, only for a linked loaded session, rejects oversized answers through the existing MAX_DECISION_ANSWER_BYTES limit, and returns status/detail instead of auto-retrying.

resource_risks.description: The linked session may already be finished or unavailable.
resource_risks.mitigation: The command checks loaded session presence, finished state, and stdin availability before writing; answer persistence remains valid even when resume cannot proceed.

resource_risks.description: Decision answer persistence writes to the shared human decision inbox JSON.
resource_risks.mitigation: The existing workspace-scoped human decision inbox path and pretty JSON write helper are reused.

lifecycle_checks.resource: decision inbox and CLI session stdin
lifecycle_checks.create_path: answer_and_resume_human_decision saves the decision answer, then writes to linked active session stdin if available.
lifecycle_checks.cleanup_path: No persistent file handle is retained; no new child process is created; the existing session lifecycle remains managed by poll/cancel/timeout.

measurement_checks.threshold: Answer text is bounded by MAX_DECISION_ANSWER_BYTES and readiness checks include answer_and_resume_human_decision.

notes: This slice does not create a new process, timer, browser context, cache, or worker.
